title: Route Popularity and Ticket Sales Volume
description_markdown: Route profitability request: For each origin and destination city pair, join `flights` and `tickets`. Count total passengers flown as `ticket_count`. Return `f.origin`, `f.destination`, and `ticket_count`. Order by `ticket_count` DESC, `f.origin` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Route volume summary
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT f.origin, f.destination, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS ticket_count FROM flights f JOIN tickets t ON f.flight_id = t.flight_id GROUP BY f.origin, f.destination ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, f.origin ASC, f.destination ASC;

title: Compile Passenger Global Booking History Summary
description_markdown: For each passenger, compute `full_name`, `frequent_flyer_miles`, `total_bookings`, and `confirmed_spend` (sum of confirmed bookings, defaulting to 0.0). Order by `confirmed_spend` DESC, `total_bookings` DESC, `passenger_id` ASC.
starter_query:

SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT p.passenger_id, CONCAT(p.first_name, ' ', p.last_name) AS full_name, p.frequent_flyer_miles, COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.booking_status = 'confirmed' THEN b.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0.0) AS confirmed_spend FROM passengers p LEFT JOIN bookings b ON p.passenger_id = b.passenger_id GROUP BY p.passenger_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.frequent_flyer_miles ORDER BY confirmed_spend DESC, total_bookings DESC, p.passenger_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Joins passengers with bookings, computing conditional confirmed spend and booking count.

Use `COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.booking_status = 'confirmed' THEN b.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0.0) AS confirmed_spend`.

Query: SELECT p.passenger_id, (p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name) AS full_name, p.frequent_flyer_miles, COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.booking_status = 'confirmed' THEN b.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0.0) AS confirmed_spend FROM passengers p LEFT JOIN bookings b ON p.passenger_id = b.passenger_id GROUP BY p.passenger_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.frequent_flyer_miles ORDER BY confirmed_spend DESC, total_bookings DESC, p.passenger_id ASC;
